put.summary:
Generates a transfer of an integrated schedule appointment to a new date, time, or location. The process involves two stored procedures: `ATUALIZA_DADOS_MARCACAO` (to update the appointment marking data) and `CONFIRMAR_TRANSFERENCIA_AGEINT` (to confirm and finalize the transfer). 

**Required fields:** `scheduleId`, `scheduleDate`, `integratedScheduleId`.

get.summary: Retrieve integrated schedule appointment attachments by filters
get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of attachments that belong to the given integrated schedule appointment, optionally filtered by file name (case-insensitive partial match). Each attachment includes its Base64-encoded file content. Returns 200 OK with a populated page when attachments are found, or an empty page (content: []) when no attachments match the filters. Returns 400 when the appointment identifier is invalid or the pagination parameters are invalid. Returns 404 when the appointment does not exist. 

 Check the TIE configuration documentation under the 'Guides > Schedules use case > Schedule attachments configuration' tab.

get.summary: Retrieve an integrated schedule appointment attachment by identifier
get.description:
Retrieves a single attachment that belongs to an integrated schedule appointment, including its Base64-encoded file content. The attachment is resolved by both the appointment identifier and the attachment identifier, so an attachment that is not linked to the given appointment is treated as not found. Returns 200 OK when the attachment is found. Returns 400 when the appointment or attachment identifier is null or lower than one. Returns 404 when the appointment does not exist or the attachment does not belong to it. 

Check the TIE configuration documentation under the 'Guides > Schedules use case > Schedule attachments configuration' tab.

delete.summary: Delete an integrated schedule appointment attachment
delete.description: Permanently deletes the attachment record that belongs to an integrated schedule appointment. Only the database record is removed; the file stored in TasyStorage is not deleted. The attachment is resolved by both the appointment identifier and the attachment identifier, so an attachment that is not linked to the given appointment is treated as not found. Returns 204 No Content when the attachment is deleted. Returns 400 when the appointment or attachment identifier is null or lower than one. Returns 404 when the appointment does not exist or the attachment does not belong to it.
